description: the CALL ... ON OVERFLOW phrase — the COBOL-74-carried synonym of ON EXCEPTION, valid 85–2014 and REMOVED at 2023 (Annex E.2 item 1c; use ON EXCEPTION). Folded from the inline COBOL0882 binder gate (P2.6b).
citation: ISO 2023 Annex E.2 item 1c (removed 2023; use ON EXCEPTION); §1985:X.5.2.2 (CHANGED); §1985:X.5.2.4 GR3
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMCO.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    CALL "SUB" ON OVERFLOW CONTINUE.
    STOP RUN.
